title: Downloading Files with Python (requests + zip)
evaluates: extra credit: async/concurrent downloads + unit tests
requirements: Create a downloads/ directory with Python if it doesn't exist
Download 10 zip files one by one from the HTTP URIs listed in main.py
Extract the filename from each URI keeping the original name
Unzip each file to CSV and delete the zip
Handle invalid URIs gracefully
Extra credit: download async with aiohttp / ThreadPoolExecutor and add unit tests
diagram: flowchart LR; A[HTTP URIs in main.py] --> B[requests.get each file]; B --> C[Write .zip to downloads/]; C --> D[Unzip to .csv]; D --> E[Delete .zip]
preview: Practica descarga de archivos por HTTP con requests, extraccion de nombre desde la URI, y descompresion de zips a CSV en una carpeta creada por codigo.
portfolio_value: Fundamento de ingesta: descarga robusta de archivos y manejo de I/O; el extra credit (async + tests) demuestra concurrencia.
notes: Corre en Docker (docker-compose up run). URIs en main.py.

title: Web Scraping + File Download (NOAA weather)
evaluates: HTML scraping to locate a file by Last Modified timestamp
requirements: Scrape https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/data/local-climatological-data/access/2021/
Find the filename whose Last Modified is 2024-01-19 10:27 (no manual lookup)
Build the download URL and save the file locally
Load it into Pandas and find record(s) with the highest HourlyDryBulbTemperature
Print those records to stdout
diagram: flowchart LR; A[Scrape NOAA index HTML] --> B[Match Last Modified 2024-01-19 10:27]; B --> C[Build file URL]; C --> D[Download CSV]; D --> E[Pandas load]; E --> F[Print max HourlyDryBulbTemperature rows]
preview: Scrapea un indice HTML de NOAA para ubicar un archivo por su fecha de modificacion, lo descarga y analiza la temperatura maxima con Pandas.
portfolio_value: Combina web scraping y analisis con Pandas: util para ingestas desde portales gubernamentales sin API.
notes: Corre en Docker. Requiere acceso a internet al sitio de NOAA.

title: Boto3 + AWS S3 (Common Crawl streaming)
evaluates: boto3 S3 download from a public bucket
extra credit: in-memory streaming without touching disk
requirements: Use boto3 to download bucket=commoncrawl key=crawl-data/CC-MAIN-2022-05/wet.paths.gz
Extract and open the gz file (plain text)
Pull the URI from the first line
Download that second S3 file with boto3 and print each line to stdout
Extra credit: stream the final file instead of loading it all into memory; download/extract the gz fully in memory
diagram: flowchart LR; A[boto3 get wet.paths.gz from commoncrawl] --> B[gunzip in memory]; B --> C[Read first-line URI]; C --> D[boto3 get that S3 object]; D --> E[Stream lines to stdout]
preview: Usa boto3 contra el bucket publico commoncrawl de S3: descarga un .gz, lo descomprime y encadena la descarga de un segundo archivo por streaming.
portfolio_value: Unico ejercicio del set con AWS S3 real (boto3); el extra credit de streaming demuestra manejo eficiente de memoria.
notes: Bucket publico, sin credenciales especiales. Corre en Docker; requiere salida a internet/S3.

title: JSON to CSV over Ragged Directories
requirements: Crawl the data/ directory and find all JSON files
Load each JSON file
Flatten nested structures (e.g. {type:Point, coordinates:[...]})
Write one CSV per JSON file including header names
diagram: flowchart LR; A[Crawl data/ with glob] --> B[Find .json files]; B --> C[Load JSON]; C --> D[Flatten nested fields]; D --> E[Write matching .csv with headers]
preview: Recorre una estructura de directorios irregular, encuentra archivos JSON, aplana sus campos anidados y los convierte a CSV uno a uno.
portfolio_value: Patron clasico de normalizacion: aplanar JSON anidado a tabular, base de muchos pipelines de ingesta.
notes: Datos incluidos en Exercise-4/data. Corre en Docker.

title: Data Modeling for Postgres (DDL + psycopg2 ingest)
evaluates: DDL design with proper data types
requirements: Inspect each of the 3 CSV files in data/ and design a CREATE statement per file
Choose sensible data types; include indexes plus primary and foreign keys
Connect to Postgres on localhost (Docker-spun) with psycopg2
Create the tables against the database
Ingest each CSV into its table with psycopg2
diagram: flowchart LR; A[Inspect 3 CSVs in data/] --> B[Design DDL: types, PK/FK, indexes]; B --> C[psycopg2 connect to Postgres]; C --> D[CREATE TABLEs]; D --> E[Ingest CSVs]
preview: Disena el modelo relacional (DDL con tipos, PK/FK e indices) para 3 CSVs y los ingesta en Postgres usando psycopg2.
portfolio_value: Demuestra modelado de datos relacional y carga programatica a Postgres, habilidad core de un DE junior.
notes: Docker levanta el Postgres automaticamente. main.py trae la conexion preconfigurada.

title: Ingestion and Aggregation with PySpark (Divvy trips)
requirements: Read the two zipped CSVs with PySpark (keep them zipped)
Report average trip duration per day
Report number of trips per day
Most popular starting station per month
Top 3 trip stations per day for the last two weeks
Whether Males or Females take longer trips on average
Top 10 ages with longest and shortest trips
Output each answer as a CSV in a reports/ folder; encapsulate code in functions
diagram: flowchart LR; A[Read zipped Divvy CSVs in PySpark] --> B[Daily/monthly aggregations]; B --> C[Window top-N stations]; C --> D[Demographic analyses]; D --> E[Write CSV reports/]
preview: Primer ejercicio Big Data: lee CSV comprimidos con PySpark y responde 6 preguntas analiticas (agregaciones diarias, top-N por ventana, demografia) escribiendo reportes CSV.
portfolio_value: Introduce PySpark con agregaciones y window functions reales; transferible directo a Databricks.
notes: Datos zip en Exercise-6/data, deben permanecer comprimidos. Corre en Docker.

title: PySpark Functions (Backblaze hard-drive failures)
requirements: Add source_file column with the file name
Extract the date from source_file as a date/timestamp column file_date
Add brand column derived from model (split on space, else 'unknown')
Build a secondary DataFrame ranking models by capacity_bytes and join storage_ranking back
Add primary_key as a hash of the record-unique columns
Use only spark.sql.functions, no UDFs or Python methods; encapsulate in functions
diagram: flowchart LR; A[Read zipped failures CSV in PySpark] --> B[Add source_file + parse file_date]; B --> C[Derive brand from model]; C --> D[Rank capacity_bytes -> storage_ranking join]; D --> E[Hash primary_key]
preview: Resuelve 5 transformaciones sobre datos de fallas de discos usando exclusivamente spark.sql.functions (sin UDFs): file metadata, parsing de fecha, derivacion condicional, ranking por join y hash key.
portfolio_value: Demuestra dominio idiomatico de la API de funciones de Spark SQL, evitando UDFs (clave para performance en Databricks).
notes: La restriccion no-UDF es el punto del ejercicio. Datos zip en data/. Corre en Docker.

title: Understanding and Using DuckDB (EV cars analytics)
requirements: Create a DuckDB table with DDL and correct data types (not all String)
Read electric-cars.csv into the table
Count electric cars per city
Find top 3 most popular EVs
Most popular EV per postal code
Count EVs by model year and write as Parquet partitioned by year
diagram: flowchart LR; A[DuckDB DDL with typed columns] --> B[Load electric-cars.csv]; B --> C[Analytics: per-city, top-3, per-postal]; C --> D[Count by model year]; D --> E[Write partitioned Parquet]
preview: Modela y carga un CSV de vehiculos electricos en DuckDB con tipos correctos, corre analiticas SQL y exporta Parquet particionado por anio.
portfolio_value: DuckDB es OLAP embebido cada vez mas usado; cubre DDL tipado, SQL analitico y escritura Parquet particionada.
notes: Datos electric-cars.csv en data/. Corre en Docker.

title: Lazy Computation with Polars (Divvy bike trips)
requirements: Read the CSV into a lazy Polars DataFrame
Cast all columns to correct types
Count bike rides per day
Compute average, max and minimum rides per week
For each day, compute how many rides above/below the same day last week
diagram: flowchart LR; A[scan_csv -> Polars LazyFrame] --> B[Cast types]; B --> C[Rides per day]; C --> D[Weekly avg/max/min]; D --> E[Day vs same-day-last-week delta]
preview: Usa la API Lazy de Polars para procesar datos mayores que memoria: casteo de tipos, conteos diarios, estadisticas semanales y comparacion semana contra semana.
portfolio_value: Polars lazy es una alternativa moderna a Pandas para datasets grandes; demuestra evaluacion diferida y window analysis.
notes: Datos 202306-divvy-tripdate.csv en data/. Corre en Docker.

title: Data Quality with Great Expectations (bike trip durations)
evaluates: integrating DQ checks into an existing pipeline
requirements: Use Great Expectations to assert trips start and end on the same day
The existing dataset contains erroneous (too-long) trip durations
Running the pipeline (docker-compose up run) should raise data quality errors that flag those records
diagram: flowchart LR; A[Existing pipeline reads divvy CSV] --> B[Compute trip duration]; B --> C[Great Expectations DQ suite]; C --> D{Same-day / valid duration?}; D -->|No| E[Raise DQ alert]; D -->|Yes| F[Pass]
preview: Implementa checks de calidad con Great Expectations sobre un pipeline existente para detectar duraciones de viaje erroneas; al correr debe disparar errores de DQ.
portfolio_value: Unico ejercicio de data quality del set y el mas avanzado (Tier Advanced); el pipeline se auto-valida al fallar ante datos malos.
notes: Tier Advanced. El pipeline ya existe en main.py; el alumno agrega las expectativas. Se auto-valida porque debe levantar errores.

title: PySpark ETL Job Best-Practices Template
evaluates: separating Extract/Transform/Load with a testable idempotent transform
meaningful unit tests on the transform
requirements: Structure ETL as extract_data / transform_data / load_data with main() orchestration
Isolate the transform as a pure, idempotent, testable function over DataFrames
Pass configuration via configs/etl_config.json sent with --files
Package dependencies into packages.zip (build_dependencies.sh) sent with --py-files
Use start_spark() (dependencies/spark.py) for context-aware session + logger + config
Run via spark-submit; cover the transform with unit tests in tests/test_etl_job.py
diagram: flowchart LR; subgraph spark-submit; CFG[configs/etl_config.json --files] --> M; PKG[packages.zip --py-files] --> M; end; M[main in etl_job.py] --> E[extract_data]; E --> T[transform_data idempotent]; T --> L[load_data]; T -.tested by.-> TEST[tests/test_etl_job.py]
preview: Template de referencia de un ETL job PySpark productivo: separa E/T/L con un transform idempotente y testeable, config externa por JSON, empaquetado de dependencias en packages.zip y arranque de sesion consciente del contexto.
portfolio_value: Plantilla canonica de best-practices para estructurar y testear jobs Spark productivos; ideal como esqueleto de proyecto y para mostrar criterio de ingenieria.
notes: No es un take-home, no tiene enunciado: es un proyecto template completo (has_solution=true). Branch master. Trae tests unitarios que se ejecutan sobre el transform.

title: Databricks Autoloader + Delta Lake Medallion Pipeline
evaluates: synthetic test data generation with Faker
requirements: Bronze: ingest customers/orders/order_items/products CSVs from (simulated) S3 with Autoloader into Delta, adding ingest_datetime and batch_id
Silver: cleanse and deduplicate with PySpark Window functions
Gold: build analytics-ready dimensions/facts including SCD1 and SCD2 customer dimension
Reporting: expose final analytical queries/tables
Optionally generate synthetic source data with Faker via resources/Generate_test_data.ipynb
diagram: flowchart LR; S[(S3 CSV: customers/orders/order_items/products)] --> B[Bronze: Autoloader -> Delta + ingest_datetime/batch_id]; B --> SV[Silver: cleanse + dedup Window fns]; SV --> G[Gold: dims/facts SCD1+SCD2]; G --> R[Reporting: analytics tables]; TG[Generate_test_data Faker] -.seeds.-> S
preview: Pipeline OLTP->OLAP end-to-end en Databricks: ingesta con Autoloader a Delta (Bronze), limpieza y dedup con Window functions (Silver), dimensiones SCD1/SCD2 (Gold) y capa de Reporting, sobre datos de clientes/ordenes/items/productos.
portfolio_value: Proyecto Databricks completo que muestra arquitectura medallion real con Autoloader, Delta y modelado SCD; el mas representativo del stack Databricks empresarial.
notes: Requiere Databricks + S3 (rutas simuladas de un final exam de training de40); no corre local. Rubro inferido de resources/Generate_test_data.ipynb (catalog de_pyspark_training_catalog, schema buddy_group_1, tablas amanolov_*_exam). Branch main. 4 notebooks Bronze/Silver/Gold/Reporting.
